name: Talondeep Path
summary: Talondeep Path cuts beneath the ridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. The quiet tunnel links the woods west of Mystral Lake to Windshear Crag.

sections.title: A Quiet Mountain Pass
sections.body: Talondeep Path runs beneath the ridge between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains. The tunnel links the woods west of Mystral Lake to the northwestern reaches of Windshear Crag. Surface trails cross dangerous country, with predators and warring factions, but the passage is calm and has no hostile beasts or encampments. Twisting side pockets, crevices, and natural alcoves break up the rock. Above ground, faint traces of an old road remain along the peaks, where travelers once crossed before the sheltered route through the stone.

faq.q: Where does the Talondeep Path lead?
faq.answer: Talondeep Path connects southwestern Ashenvale to the northeastern Stonetalon Mountains. Its northern entrance lies just west of Mystral Lake, and its southern mouth opens into northwestern Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Are there monsters or enemies inside the tunnel?
faq.answer: No hostile creatures live inside Talondeep Path. The cavern is peaceful and has no hostile beasts or friendly folk, leaving travelers a safe passage through the mountain divide.

faq.q: What are the ruins above the cavern?
faq.answer: The ruins above Talondeep Path are remnants of an overgrown road along the mountain ridge. They suggest travelers once crossed the crags by a treacherous surface route before the tunnel passage.

faq.q: Is Talondeep Path an Alliance or Horde tunnel?
faq.answer: Neither faction holds Talondeep Path. The unfortified tunnel is neutral wilderness, open to travelers of any allegiance moving between the contested forest and the mountains.

angles.text: The winding rock alcoves cut through the mountain range's deep stone foundation. They make Talondeep Path a natural landmark when traveling between mineral-rich Ashenvale and Stonetalon.
